**Plan summary:** Trishuli shelter is the only evacuation point. Dupcheshwar temple is on higher ground but isn't designated, so nobody can be dropped off there.

The closed Trishuli–Naukunda road means every trip has to go through Gosaikunda temple.

| Group | Round trip from Trishuli | Deferral penalty | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Naukunda farm (4 adults) | 46 min | 80 | Rescue |
| Dupcheshwar temple (4 adults) | 72 min | 80 | Rescue |
| Bidur village (2 adults) | 116 min, or 44 min extra if added to the Dupcheshwar trip | 40 | Defer |

**Why deferring Bidur is cheapest:** Adding Bidur to the Dupcheshwar trip costs 44 extra minutes to save a 40 penalty, and the car only has room for four. Those two passengers would displace two Dupcheshwar labourers, which adds another 40 in penalties.

| Option | Calculation | Total cost |
|---|---|---|
| **Rescue Naukunda and Dupcheshwar, defer Bidur** | **46 + 72 + 40** | **158** |
| Rescue Naukunda only, defer the rest | 46 + 120 | 166 |
| Rescue Naukunda, Bidur and 2 from Dupcheshwar, defer the other 2 | 46 + 116 + 40 | 202 |
| Rescue everyone | 46 + 72 + 116 | 234 |

**Assumption:** The report doesn't give the shopkeepers' ages or say whether they are injured, so I counted them as adults. If either is injured, a child or elderly, the higher penalty could change the decision, so this should be confirmed.
